data.name: The Good Book VN
data.detailed_description:
The Good Book VN is a powerful and emotional visual novel that uses text and images to deliver a raw, authentic, and compelling fictional story set in 1980s–1990s England.

With over 50 pages of rich narrative, it follows the life of a young teenager who makes the wrong choices and gets pulled into a world of gangs, drugs, and violence. witness his struggle with crime, punishment, and the heavy cost of street life — but also his potential for transformation and redemption through faith, reflection, and difficult life lessons.

Key Themes:

  • Crime & Punishment in working-class UK

  • Gang culture, violence, drugs, and prison life

  • Life choices and turning points

  • Finding Jesus Christ

  • Recognizing the lies and traps of the devil

Quote from the Author:

"Don’t choose the gun or the knife – choose your life."
Thank you for supporting my work.

Navigation Instructions:

  • Press Next to continue through the pages of the visual novel

  • Press Main to return to the beginning

  • 🎧 Soundtrack Notice:

    This visual novel contains no soundtrack. Feel free to play your own Cinematic Suspense music while reading, Dark, Crime, Thriller

data.legal_notice:
The Good Book
By MB aka FRANK
A Visual Novel: Crime, Punishment, and Redemption

Description:
The Good Book is a gripping visual novel crafted for digital gaming platforms. Blending powerful storytelling with engaging visuals, this work explores themes of crime, punishment, survival, transformation, and spiritual awakening.

Presented through sequential text and imagery, this is a fictional narrative inspired by real-life experiences, reimagined through the lens of faith, consequence, and redemption.

Disclaimer:
This is a work of fiction.
Names, characters, businesses, places, events, and incidents are either the product of the author’s imagination or have been fictionalized. Any resemblance to actual persons, living or dead, is purely coincidental.

Content Warning:
This visual novel may contain themes of an adult nature, including:

Strong language

Crime and punishment

Gang violence

Drugs, guns, and prison life

Lifestyle challenges and advice

Encounters with faith: finding Jesus Christ

Recognizing deception and the lies of the devil

Viewer discretion is advised.
